new: A new story on the Experiments set: Invisible threads, the chemical exposome (Lombardo, Hütter, Unterlass, Menche, Nature Communications 2026). Nearly 10,000 substances all around you, sorted first by chemistry and then by the genes they disturb (the authors' own 3D layout), the blood-clotting group close up, the model cell from Back into the cell and its proteins sorted with hubs in the middle, asthma and ozone, and Europe on the airports globe. About ten minutes, with a synthetic voice.
Its explore mode has four tabs: Substances (search any of 9,764), Groups (three levels, in plain words), Diseases and Countries.
All numbers come from the authors' data deposit (Zenodo, CC BY 4.0); only derived numbers ship. Where the deposit differs from the paper's text is in docs/questions-for-authors.md.
Still untried: v211's wwiznet export, v210's two voices, v209 to v200 (shared networks, the Network tab, worn characters, the mirror robot).
